The Std_ReturnType shall normally be used with value E_OK or E_NOT_OK. If those return values are not sufficient user specific values can be defined by using the 6 least specific bits. For the naming of the user defined values the module prefix shall be used as requested in SRS_BSW_00441 Layout of the Std_ReturnType shall be as stated in the RTE specification. Bit 7 and Bit 8 are reserved and defined by the RTE specification.
